failures.question: How much is the bounce fee when a UPI AutoPay mandate fails due to insufficient balance?
failures.actual:
The bounce fee for a UPI AutoPay mandate failure due to insufficient balance is ₹500 plus 18% GST per bounce occurrence as per FinBase Personal Loans policy [1][2][3]. Additionally, the payment system protocol for mandate insufficient balance (Response Code: U88) confirms that a standard bounce fee is levied [4].

Note: Section 21 and Section 4.2 of the FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Opera

answers.answer: If you close your personal loan after 18 months, which is before completing 24 months, the foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal balance plus 18% GST, as per FinBase Personal Loan Policy Section 4.2 and FAQ Q001. This applies to all retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-02 [1][2][4].

answers.answer:
The age limits for a personal loan applicant at FinBase are:

Your failed UPI debit transaction will be automatically reversed and credited back to your account within T+2 business days (where T is the transaction date) as per RBI and NPCI guidelines [1][2]. If the reversal is delayed beyond T+2 business days, FinBase compensates ₹100 per calendar day of delay [1].

Note: This T+2 business days reversal applies specifically to P2P UPI failed debits. Other transaction scenarios have different timelines and compensation rules [4].

answers.question: When is TDS deducted on FD interest and at what rate?

Customers whose estimated total annual income is below the taxable threshold can submit Form 15G (for individuals below 60 years) or Form 15H (for senior citizens aged 60+) digitally via the FinBase App to avoid TDS deduction [1][3].

answers.question: Which documents are accepted as Officially Valid Documents for KYC?

1. Aadhaar Card (via UIDAI DigiLocker OTP or masked paper e-Aadhaar)

3. Indian Passport (must be valid and unexpired)
4. Driving License (smart card or verifiable DigiLocker document)
5. Voter ID Card (issued by the Election Commission of India) [1][3].

answers.question: What are the Video KYC timings and what do I need to have ready?
answers.answer: Video KYC agents are available Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST, and they are closed on national holidays. For the Video KYC process, you need to have the original physical PAN card (laminated original; screenshots or photocopies are not accepted), a blank white sheet of paper, and a black or blue pen for live on-camera signature capture. Additionally, you must have a high-speed internet connection, an active smartphone or laptop camera and microphone, and device geolocation (GPS) enabled to verify your physical presence within India during the video session [1][2][3].

answers.question: What extra benefit do senior citizens get on FDs, and what is the TDS threshold for them?
answers.answer:
Senior citizens (aged 60 and above) receive an extra 0.50% p.a. interest rate advantage on all fixed deposit tenures compared to regular customers. For example, on a 1-year to less than 2-year FD, the senior citizen rate is 8.00% p.a. versus 7.50% p.a. for regular customers. This extra 0.50% p.a. applies across all deposit tenures [2][4].

The TDS threshold for senior citizens is ₹50,000 of total annual interest income across all deposits in a financial year. If the interest income exceeds this, TDS is deducted at 10%. Senior citizens can also submit Form 15H digitally via the FinBase App to avoid TDS if their estimated total income is below the taxable threshold [1].
